mechanism_of_action: Described as modulating inflammation, oxidative stress, hepatic fat accumulation, and fibrosis.
primary_endpoint: Change in tumor necrosis factor (TNF) levels over 12 months.
efficacy_outcome: TNF levels were significantly lower with curcumin than placebo at all follow-up points (p < 0.001). IL-1β, IL-6, and malondialdehyde also declined, antioxidant enzyme activities increased (all p < 0.001), and hepatic steatosis and liver stiffness significantly improved versus placebo; no numerical effect sizes were reported.
